# ReadList

`schemas/api/read-list.json`

A read of one resource, GET /v1/{resource} (docs/design/m0/08 "Reads"): the records the caller's read scope covers, each authorized against its domain and authoritative project in the same snapshot as the caller's scope, and each carrying only its resource's allow-listed fields. found when any record is returned, else empty.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `resource` | yes | string (pattern `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$`, maxLength `64`) |  |
| `outcome` | yes | one of `found`, `empty` |  |
| `items` | yes | array of object (open payload) |  |

No other fields are allowed.
